sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plans" ("days" TEXT NOT NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "sequence" INTEGER NULL, "title" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "image" TEXT NULL, "default_rest_duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "graph_metric" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'bestWeight', "graph_period" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'day', "graph_limit" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 20, "graph_time_based_x_axis" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("graph_time_based_x_axis" IN (0, 1)), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workouts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "plan_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES plans (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_sets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "workout_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES workouts (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reps" REAL NULL, "load_kg" REAL NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "distance_metres" REAL NULL, "incline" REAL NULL, "body_weight_kg" REAL NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "body_weights" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "photo" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("alarm_sound" TEXT NOT NULL, "automatic_backups" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("automatic_backups" IN (0, 1)), "backup_path" TEXT NULL, "build_number" INTEGER NULL, "cardio_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "curve_lines" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("curve_lines" IN (0, 1)), "curve_smoothness" REAL NULL, "fill_chart_area" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("fill_chart_area" IN (0, 1)), "duration_estimation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("duration_estimation" IN (0, 1)), "enable_sound" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enable_sound" IN (0, 1)), "explained_permissions" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("explained_permissions" IN (0, 1)), "group_history" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("group_history" IN (0, 1)), "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "long_date_format" TEXT NOT NULL, "locale_override" TEXT NULL, "max_sets" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notifications" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("notifications" IN (0, 1)), "notification_permission_requested" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("notification_permission_requested" IN (0, 1)), "peek_graph" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("peek_graph" IN (0, 1)), "plan_trailing" TEXT NOT NULL, "rest_timers" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("rest_timers" IN (0, 1)), "short_date_format" TEXT NOT NULL, "show_body_weight" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("show_body_weight" IN (0, 1)), "show_categories" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("show_categories" IN (0, 1)), "show_chart_gridlines" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("show_chart_gridlines" IN (0, 1)), "show_images" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("show_images" IN (0, 1)), "show_notes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("show_notes" IN (0, 1)), "show_global_progress" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("show_global_progress" IN (0, 1)), "show_units" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("show_units" IN (0, 1)), "strength_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "system_colors" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("system_colors" IN (0, 1)), "seed_color" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4284955319, "tabs" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'HistoryPage,PlansPage,GraphsPage,TimerPage', "theme_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "timer_duration" INTEGER NOT NULL, "vibrate" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("vibrate" IN (0, 1)), "warmup_sets" INTEGER NULL, "scrollable_tabs" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("scrollable_tabs" IN (0, 1)), "show_graph_x_axis" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("show_graph_x_axis" IN (0, 1)), "show_graph_limit" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("show_graph_limit" IN (0, 1)), "progress_position" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'bottom', "default_graph_metric" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'bestWeight', "default_graph_period" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'day', "default_graph_limit" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30, "default_graph_time_based_x_axis" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("default_graph_time_based_x_axis" IN (0, 1)), "keep_ringing" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("keep_ringing" IN (0, 1)), "keep_screen_on" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("keep_screen_on" IN (0, 1)), "input_style" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'underline');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plan_exercises" ("enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "timers" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("timers" IN (0, 1)), "exercise_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "max_sets" INTEGER NULL, "plan_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES plans (id), "warmup_sets" INTEGER NULL, "sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);
CREATE INDEX workouts_plan_ended_started ON workouts (plan_id, ended_at, started_at DESC, id DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workouts_active_plan ON workouts (plan_id) WHERE ended_at IS NULL AND plan_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX exercise_sets_timestamp ON exercise_sets (timestamp, id)
CREATE INDEX exercise_sets_exercise_timestamp ON exercise_sets (exercise_id, timestamp DESC, id DESC)
CREATE INDEX exercise_sets_workout_exercise ON exercise_sets (workout_id, exercise_id, timestamp, id)
CREATE INDEX body_weights_timestamp ON body_weights (timestamp DESC, id DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX plan_exercises_plan_exercise ON plan_exercises (plan_id, exercise_id)
